company_name: Wuxi Jerome Precision Mechanics Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Wuxi Jerome Precision Mechanics Co., Ltd. specializes in die bonding tools and device handling tools, which are critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Wuxi Jerome Precision Mechanics Co., Ltd. is a manufacturer of die bonding tools and device handling tools for the semiconductor industry. They offer a range of products including FOL magazines, wafer frames, and various die bonding tools, as well as calibration and repair services.
capabilities: Device handling tools including wafer cassettes and stack magazines
Die bonding tools such as epoxy nozzles and high temperature rubber tips
Calibration services in collaboration with MPC
Cleaning and testing machines for semiconductor applications
technical_expertise: Calibration and maintenance of semiconductor equipment

regional_presence.China: The company is based in Wuxi, China, and provides services and products tailored to the local semiconductor market.
